subject: Your administrator account on the MaiAn platform has been activated
title: Please log in and change your password as soon as possible
content:
Dear Administrator {adminName}, your administrator account on the MaiAn platform has been successfully created and activated. Your account is: {email}.
To help you get started quickly, the system has generated a temporary password: {temporaryPassword}
ignore: To ensure your account’s security, please change your password immediately after your first login. If you did not register on the MaiAn platform, please ignore this email.
support: If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact our customer support team. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
